summary: Which wayfinder conventions exist in the wild across versions of `mattpocock/skills`?

resolution.gist: Three generations of wayfinder state shipped: a single Markdown file with Type:/Status:/Blocked by: lines, an early tracker map with Notes/Decisions/Fog body, and the current tracker map with Destination/Notes/Decisions/Not yet specified/Out of scope; the wayfinder:claimed label was never released and assignees are the claim since then.
